boundaryReplacedWith.afterTheMarker: the attempt is consumed whatever happens next, and a failure is reported as a hard stop rather than retried
boundaryReplacedWith.beforeTheMarker: every refusal is free and may be repeated
boundaryReplacedWith.howItIsWritten: built in full, written to a neighbouring name that is not the marker, fsynced, renamed into place, and the directory entry fsynced after it -- so a run that dies halfway leaves the marker absent rather than half written
boundaryReplacedWith.preservedOnFailure: echoed to the console the host already collects, and uploaded on its own when a replica fails; a half-written image is not uploaded
boundaryReplacedWith.whyNotTheDirectory: a systemd ReadWritePaths entry has to exist before the transient unit starts, so the output directory is something the isolation requires rather than something the phase decided.  A boundary a run can cross without meaning to is a boundary that gets argued about afterwards.
boundaryReplacedWith.writtenWhen: immediately before the first image output file
